# crimemappingdata

The crimemappingdata package contains a variety of datasets that are
useful in learning crime mapping. These datasets are used in the book
[*Learn Crime Mapping with
R*](https://books.lesscrime.info/learncrimemapping/) but are also
available for use by anyone else in accordance with the licence shown in
the documentation for each dataset.

## Installation

You can install crimemappingdata from
[GitHub](https://github.com/mpjashby/crimemappingdata/) with:

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mpjashby/crimemappingdata")
```

## Available datasets

The following datasets are available, both as:

- R data that can be called using the
  [`data()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html) function,
  e.g. `data(aggravated_assaults)`, and
- stand-alone files that can be downloaded in the formats shown below.

See the manual page for each dataset
(e.g. [`?aggravated_assaults`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/aggravated_assaults.md))
for the corresponding stand-alone file URL. Different stand-alone
datasets are provided in different file formats (including spatial and
non-spatial formats) to give the opportunity for students to practice
loading files of different types (e.g. using
[`readr::read_csv()`](https://readr.tidyverse.org/reference/read_delim.html)
or
[`readxl::read_excel()`](https://readxl.tidyverse.org/reference/read_excel.html)).

![World map showing the locations of the datasets included in the
package.](reference/figures/dataset_coords.png)

World map showing the locations of the datasets included in the package.

Note that gzipped CSV files (with the file extension `.csv.gz`) can be
opened using
[`readr::read_csv()`](https://readr.tidyverse.org/reference/read_delim.html)
and functions from other packages, but not `base::read.csv()`.

You can find more details about each dataset in the vignette
[`vignette("dataset_summary")`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/articles/dataset_summary.md).

## Using the data in teaching

For suggestions on how to use the data in this package for teaching, as
well as details of each dataset, see the vignette
[`vignette("teaching")`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/articles/teaching.md).

## Data licences

This package is licensed under the MIT Licence, but the individual
datasets have been licensed by the data provider using a variety of
different open-data licences. Check the manual page for each dataset for
details of the relevant licence. Users are responsible for using the
data in accordance with the applicable licence for a dataset.

# Package index

## Point-level crime data

Datasets in which each row represents information about a single crime
or incident, including information about the crime/incident location.

- [`aggravated_assaults`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/aggravated_assaults.md)
  : Aggravated assaults in Austin in 2019
- [`bronx_shootings`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/bronx_shootings.md)
  : Shootings in the Bronx in 2019
- [`buenos_aires_robbery`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/buenos_aires_robbery.md)
  : Buenos Aires robberies in 2023
- [`cdmx_car_jacking`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/cdmx_car_jacking.md)
  : Car jackings in Mexico City

  : Aggravated assaults in Chicago, 2010 to 2019

  : Burglaries in Cincinnati, 2016 to 2018

## Area-level crime data

Datasets in which each row represents the count of crimes or incidents
in an area, often for use together with a supporting dataset of area
boundaries.

- [`germany_violence_counts`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/germany_violence_counts.md)
  : Count of violence in German states
- [`japan_violence_counts`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/japan_violence_counts.md)
  : Counts of violent crime in Japan, 2012
- [`malaysia_violence_counts`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/malaysia_violence_counts.md)
  : Violent crime counts in Malaysia, 2006 to 2017
- [`northants_burglary_counts`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/northants_burglary_counts.md)
  : Counts of burglary in Northamptonshire in 2020
- [`qld_stalking`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/qld_stalking.md)
  : Stalking in Queensland from 2001 to 2022
- [`uttar_pradesh_murders`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/uttar_pradesh_murders.md)
  : Murders in Uttar Pradesh

## Supporting data

Datasets to support the use of one or more of the crime datasets, often
to enable teaching of specific techniques. Suggestions for combinations
of crime and supporting datasets are included in the relevant pages
below.

- [`buenos_aires_barrios`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/buenos_aires_barrios.md)
  : Buenos Aires barrio boundaries
- [`buenos_aires_subte_lines`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/buenos_aires_subte_lines.md)
  : Buenos Aires Subte (metro) lines

  : Buenos Aires Subte (metro) stations
- [`cdmx_alcaldias`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/cdmx_alcaldias.md)
  : Alcaldías (boroughs) of Mexico City
- [`chicago_police_districts`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/chicago_police_districts.md)

- [`japan_prefectures`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/japan_prefectures.md)

- [`lancashire_districts`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/lancashire_districts.md)

- [`medellin_metro_lines`](https://pkgs.lesscrime.info/crimemappingdata/reference/medellin_metro_lines.md)
